title: Happy deer
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff3b0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f2a900'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='32' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#d97f3f' transform='rotate(-25 30 32)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='32' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#d97f3f' transform='rotate(25 70 32)'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M36 26 L28 10 L22 16 M34 18 L26 4' fill='none' stroke='#c98a3c' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M64 26 L72 10 L78 16 M66 18 L74 4' fill='none' stroke='#c98a3c' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='24' ry='21' fill='#e08a45'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#f5c48a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='42' r='4' fill='#5a2d12'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='42' r='4' fill='#5a2d12'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='41' r='1.4' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='41' r='1.4' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#5a2d12'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='53' rx='1.2' ry='0.9' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 60 Q50 66 56 60' fill='none' stroke='#8a4a1e' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='52' r='3.5' fill='#f2726b'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='52' r='3.5' fill='#f2726b'/>
</svg>
